The "fuamá" of the scan is read as "suamá"; this may be a contraction for "suam ac" [?]. The note "i" reference "c. 7. §. 5." is hard to read exactly. The fragment at the top "stiani" is the end of "Christiani" and stays a fragment. The line at the foot "pro-" is the catchword.
